title: Custom API / Backend Service Database Access
summary: 研究 Supabase Edge Function 作為 trusted backend service 時的資料庫存取與 transaction boundary。Research Model 分為 Access Model、Operation Model、Transaction Model：先區分 service identity、object privilege 與 RLS，再比較 Native Data API CRUD 與 RPC / PostgreSQL Function 的 operation-level security，最後以 Daily Weather 類型的 Delete + Insert representative workload 驗證 atomic rollback。Optional Phase D 才研究 caller-owned composed transaction。
flow: Phase A: Edge Function → backend service identity → table privilege / RLS → Native Data API CRUD. Phase B: Edge Function → RPC → SECURITY INVOKER / DEFINER + EXECUTE boundary. Phase C: compare separate Data API DELETE + INSERT with one atomic RPC operation under forced INSERT failure. Phase D caller-owned composed transaction is optional/deferred.
